testsuite.system-out:
Tested the authorize 40 USD → partial capture 25 USD → void remainder flow in the PayPal sandbox. All checks passed. The order 67N85550R90517011 was card-funded at create time (status COMPLETED, authorization 53984335H1838011A CREATED for 40.00). A 25.00 partial capture (6WG29562W48281115, final_capture=false, COMPLETED) moved the authorization to PARTIALLY_CAPTURED. Voiding the remainder moved it to VOIDED. Negative tests passed: a second void returned PREVIOUSLY_VOIDED (422), and capturing the remaining 15.00 after the void returned AUTHORIZATION_VOIDED (422). The order view shows the authorization VOIDED and the 25.00 capture COMPLETED, and the capture links back to the authorization.
[INFO] Partial capture then void behaves per spec: Authorization 40.00 → partial capture 25.00 (status PARTIALLY_CAPTURED) → void (status VOIDED). The 25.00 capture remains COMPLETED and is retained. Both negative tests returned the documented issue codes (PREVIOUSLY_VOIDED, AUTHORIZATION_VOIDED).
[INFO] Observation: authorization amount still reports 40.00 after partial capture and void: The authorization resource's amount field stays at 40.00 after the 25.00 capture and the void. This is probably the originally authorized amount rather than a remaining balance, so it is not a defect, but integrators should derive the remaining balance from captures rather than from this field.
[INFO] Coverage gaps: Not tested: a second partial capture before voiding, a capture above the authorized amount (MAX_CAPTURE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED), refund of the 25.00 capture, the 'authorize' step as a separate API call (the card order was authorized at create time so authorize_order was skipped), and PayPal-wallet flows.
